stations.title: Wendell
stations.say: Why did the form sell squash?

stations.title: Shed counts
stations.text: Counted each morning, read a moment later.

stations.title: Order form
stations.text: Only sells what the shed can fill.

captions: Wendell asks why the form sold three boxes with squash when the shed had none.
The form asks the shed's counts, and that answer comes a moment later. Nothing tests it.
You write tests that wait for each answer, for a count, a yes, a no and an unknown item.
Now a box the shed cannot fill is not on sale.
Same counts, same form. Your tests wait for each answer before they check it.
